NeRF-MAE Masked Radiance and Density Grid Pretraining
NeRF-MAE — Masked AutoEncoders for Self-Supervised 3D Representation Learning for Neural Radiance Fields
definition: A self-supervised pretraining framework for Neural Radiance Fields that uses standard 3D Vision Transformers to learn 3D representations by masking and reconstructing patches from NeRF's radiance and density grid.
